boundary_conditions: dc_dy(0) = concentration_boundary_layer_thickness * contact_attachment_velocity * survival_fraction_under_flow / (1 + release_probability_per_switch * consolidation_time / switching_period) / effective_near_wall_diffusivity * c(0)

parameters.name: concentration_boundary_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Near-wall transport layer (viscous plus buffer sublayer) at 12-16 kn.

parameters.name: effective_near_wall_diffusivity
parameters.justification: Effective near-wall transport coefficient of 5-20 um cells.
